01. About

Who Am I?

I'm Shubham Jaiswal, a Data Scientist & ML Engineer and B.Sc. graduate (Statistics & Computer Science) from Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith (MGKVP), Varanasi — with hands-on internship experience at Amdox Technologies, Cognifyz Technologies, and Soft Nexis Technology.

My journey into data science began with a simple curiosity: how can machines learn patterns from data and make intelligent decisions? That question led me deep into Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistical Modeling, and production AI deployment — and I haven't stopped building since.

What sets me apart is that I don't just experiment in notebooks — I ship real, working applications. Every project I build goes through the complete lifecycle: data cleaning, feature engineering, model selection, evaluation, and deployment as a live, accessible web app that anyone can use right now.

I've built and deployed medical diagnosis AI, financial fraud detection, loan default risk analytics, and retail customer intelligence — each with real data and live demos. I also completed industry simulations with Deloitte and Tata (via Forage). I believe in clean code, measurable results, and engineering that works in the real world.

Outside of projects, I pursue certifications, Kaggle, and self-directed learning across ML, deep learning, and statistics. I hold the Deep Learning Specialization (DeepLearning.AI) and Mathematics for ML from Imperial College London, among others. I'm actively seeking a full-time role in Data Science, ML Engineering, or Analytics.
